title: Liver failure, portal hypertension and bile duct disease
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's liver or bile duct condition.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for PSC.

HPI
83 y.o. female pt presents for scheduled hepatology follow-up. Pt reports feeling well today. No new complaints of pruritus or fatigue. Denies abdominal pain. She is aware of her primary sclerosing cholangitis and is here for routine surveillance.

Medication List
Ursodeoxycholic acid 300mg BID
Multivitamin daily

Exam
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender, no masses.
Lungs: CTAB.
Heart: RRR.
Skin: No jaundice noted.

Assessment
1. Primary sclerosing cholangitis: Stable. Pt is asymptomatic at this time.

Plan
1. Continue current management of PSC.
2. Order yearly imaging for monitoring of biliary tree.
3. Follow up in 12 months.

Electronically signed, 
P. O'Brien, PA-C
